summary: Forest Lookouts lists an Ainsley tower in Lafayette County, FL; Mapcarta gives a 105 ft elevation. No build, staffing or fate found.

evidence.quote: Ainsley Lookout Tower is a tower in Lafayette

corrections.why: 5S-10E-31 is a township, range and section code for the site, not a managing agency. The Forest Lookouts entry names no agency.

sources.title: Ainsley Lookout Tower Map - Lafayette, Florida

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources agree that a tower named Ainsley sits in Lafayette County: the Forest Lookouts Florida list and Mapcarta. Mapcarta's page cites an OpenStreetMap tower feature, so its 105 ft elevation and latitude are map data, not a survey, and were not checked against a second source. A getamap.net search snippet gives 30.00833, -83.36556; that page was not read. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403 on read, so it is not used. The NHLR Florida index (31 lookouts) does not name Ainsley. No source gives a status, so status stays unknown. The brief's agency value 5S is the site's township-range-section code and is proposed as unknown.
